  38     if (value === undefined) {
  39       if (rules.required) errors.push(`${field} is required`);
  40       continue;
  41     }
  42     const actual = typeOf(value);
  43     if (rules.type && actual !== rules.type) {
  44       errors.push(`${field} must be of type ${rules.type}, got ${actual}`);
  45       continue;
  46     }
  47     const size = actual === 'string' || actual === 'array' ? value.length : value;
  48     if (rules.min !== undefined && size < rules.min) {
  49       errors.push(`${field} must be at least ${rules.min}`);
  50     }
  51     if (rules.max !== undefined && size > rules.max) {
  52       errors.push(`${field} must be at most ${rules.max}`);
  53     }
  54     if (rules.pattern && actual === 'string' && !rules.pattern.test(value)) {
  55       errors.push(`${field} does not match ${rules.pattern}`);
  56     }
  57     if (rules.enum && !rules.enum.includes(value)) {
  58       errors.push(`${field} must be one of: ${rules.enum.join(', ')}`);
  59     }
  60   }
  61   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  62 }
  63
  64 function assertValid(body, schema) {
  65   const result = validate(body, schema);
  66   if (!result.valid) throw new ValidationError(result.errors);
  67   return body;
  68 }
  69
  70 module.exports = { ValidationError, typeOf, isPlainObject, parseJson, validate, assertValid };
